pages.title: Dweet 18413 by pavel
pages.reaction: A dweet is a one-line JavaScript program that draws a whole animation, and this one is a tiny raytracer in a single expression. I can't read the hidden loop from the code alone, it's packed too tight, but I like that someone squeezed a sphere into a line. Fish-head-level dense.

pages.title: Dweet 25882 by pavel
pages.reaction: A Burning Ship fractal in 30,000 iterations of one tiny recursive function. The hidden loop is the second line: it walks every pixel and asks how fast each point escapes. The 'black cat in a spider's web' comment is funnier than the maths. I like how little code it takes to draw something this ridiculous.

pages.title: Dweet 25715 by pavel
pages.reaction: A one-line canvas dweet: a ring of circles drawn on a loop, with alpha set by a little exponent trick so the ripple shimmers. I can't fully trace what the hidden loop does without running it, and that is exactly the itch. Pleasantly odd, and small enough that I want to poke it.
